contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Reach out to me by my email for collaboration, consultation or general inquiries.

seishinkaiKarate.title: Seishinkai Karate
seishinkaiKarate.desc: A solo project where I handled proposal, client communication, design, development, deployment, and maintenence. I redesigned and rebuilt their 30 year old website greatly improving SEO, customer join up rate, and UX. The owner was very satisfied with the work and designated me to handle future updates.

gamerblog.title: Gamer Blog Site
gamerblog.desc: Blog site designed and developed to replace a twitch streamer/Youtuber's old site. The new design better reflects the client's CI as a gamer, and has improved UX and SEO.

artistPortfolio.title: Artist Portfolio
artistPortfolio.desc: The client asked for an LP displaying the variety of her work as an artist that users could get an understanding of at a glance. This site is reachable by QR code on her business cards, and displays hand-picked works from her most recent exhibitions. This low-tech solution helps her engagement with future clients.

gamingSite.title: Gaming Site
gamingSite.desc: Built as a personal project, this site contains in-browser playable games I build in my free-time. Currently over a dozen of my games are avaialble to play.

OzTools.title: Dev Tools Site
OzTools.desc: A utility site with 11 built-in tools for developers and designers. I add new custom built tools for my coworkers to use.

gyoren.title: Gyoren Fisheries Hokkaido
gyoren.desc: An interactive digital fish encyclopedia for Hokkaido's fisheries federation, sharing bite-sized stories about local seafood. I was head developer, making the key functionality and tech stack decisions.

mebs.title: MEBS Kids Tablet App
mebs.desc: A tablet-first educational experience for Mitsubishi Electric Building Solutions, teaching kids how elevators and escalators work. I directed and developed the project, working between the Japanese designers/client and a Malaysian development team.
mebs.alt: MEBS kids elevator and escalator exploration app preview

marugame.title: Marugame Seimen Summer Campaign
marugame.desc: A seasonal summer campaign landing page for Marugame Seimen, the udon restaurant chain. I worked as developer, building the page with Gulp against their CMS.
marugame.alt: Marugame Seimen summer campaign landing page preview
